developmentChanges.title: Shift burden normalizer
developmentChanges.reason: Separate technical fit from schedule burden by scoring evenings/weekends/on-call and weekend frequency explicitly; prevents otherwise strong support roles from ranking too high when family-time cost is material.

developmentChanges.title: Language evidence granularity
developmentChanges.reason: Store language wording as exact evidence class (active, conversational, B-level, advantage-only, unspecified) instead of inferring a CEFR level when the employer does not provide one; improves ranking honesty for A2 profile.
